record.question: Science and technology have improved water resource management in India primarily through:
options: Deploying localized cloud-seeding drones to guarantee uniform, year-round rainfall precipitation across arid and semi-arid zones
Utilizing AI-driven weather forecasting models to automate the physical cross-country diversion of overflowing rivers into canal grids.
